```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = TRUE)

library(here)
```

```{r Load data}

source(here("R", "00-config.R"))
source(here("R", "00-functions.R"))

# Load MORDOR morbidity trial data
morb_dat_raw <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "morb_tx_int.RDS"))
perm_dat_raw <- readRDS(here("data", "output", "perm_tx_int.RDS"))

# Load AMR data
amr_dat <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "amr_dat.RDS"))

```

```{r Prep data}

mls_dat <- amr_dat %>%
  dplyr::filter(ab_class == "MLS")

mls_diff <- mls_dat %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = avg_res) %>%
  mutate(res_diff = `24 months` - Baseline,
         res_fold_change = `24 months`/Baseline) %>%
  dplyr::select(grappe, res_diff, res_fold_change) %>%
  left_join(morb_dat_raw %>% dplyr::select(grappe, arm) %>% distinct(), by = "grappe")

morb_dat <- morb_dat_raw %>%
  left_join(mls_diff, by = c("grappe", "arm"))

```

# Parallel coordinates plot

```{r parallel coordinates plot}

pc_plot_dat <- mls_dat %>%
  left_join(morb_dat_raw %>% dplyr::select(grappe, arm) %>% distinct(), by = "grappe")

diff_panelA <- ggplot(pc_plot_dat,
       aes(x = phase, y = avg_res, group = grappe, color = arm)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "MLS resistance gene abundance\n(normalized reads/million)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  ggtitle("A") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    shape = 15,
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 4
  )))

diff_panelA

```

# Change in MLS from baseline to 24 mo

```{r Correlations and permutation test}

morb_cor <- morb_dat %>%
  group_by(arm, tx_type, idw_power) %>%
  summarise(cor = unname(cor.test(tx_int, res_diff, method = "spearman")$estimate), 
            corf = unname(cor.test(tx_int, res_fold_change, method = "spearman")$estimate),
            .groups = "drop")

perm_dat <- perm_dat_raw %>%
  left_join(mls_diff, by = "grappe") %>%
  group_by(perm_id, arm, tx_type, idw_power) %>%
  summarise(cor = unname(cor.test(tx_int, res_diff, method = "spearman")$estimate), 
            corf = unname(cor.test(tx_int, res_fold_change, method = "spearman")$estimate),
            .groups = "drop")

morb_cor_lookup <- morb_cor %>%
  dplyr::select(arm, tx_type, idw_power, cor, corf) %>%
  {setNames(split(., seq(nrow(.))), 
            paste(.$arm, .$idw_power, .$tx_type, sep = "_"))}

morb_cor_dists <- perm_dat %>%
  mutate(lookup_key = paste(arm, idw_power, tx_type, sep = "_")) %>%
  group_split(lookup_key, .keep = TRUE) 

morb_cor_pvals <- mclapply(morb_cor_dists, function(group_data) {
  tryCatch({
    key <- unique(group_data$lookup_key)
    obs_data <- morb_cor_lookup[[key]]
    obs_rho <- obs_data$cor
    obs_rhof <- obs_data$corf

    rho_pval <- tryCatch({
      get_two_sided_pval(obs = obs_rho, empirical_dist = group_data$cor)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
    rho_pvalf <- tryCatch({
      get_two_sided_pval(obs = obs_rhof, empirical_dist = group_data$corf)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
    tibble(
      arm = obs_data$arm[1],
      idw_power = obs_data$idw_power[1], 
      tx_type = obs_data$tx_type[1],
      rho = obs_rho,
      perm_p = rho_pval,
      rhof = obs_rhof,
      perm_pf = rho_pvalf
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error processing group:", e$message))
    # Return a row with NAs even when there's an error
    tibble(
      arm = group_data$arm[1],
      idw_power = group_data$idw_power[1], 
      tx_type = group_data$tx_type[1],
      rho = obs_rho,
      perm_p = NA_real_,
      rhof = obs_rhof,
      perm_pf = NA_real_
    )
  })
}, mc.cores = n_cores) %>%
  bind_rows()

morb_cor <- morb_cor %>%
  rename(rho = cor,
         rhof = corf) %>%
  left_join(morb_cor_pvals, 
            by = c("arm", "idw_power", "tx_type", "rho", "rhof"))

```

## Absolute change

### Descriptives

```{r abs change descriptives}
skimr::skim(morb_dat %>% dplyr::select(res_diff))

ggplot(morb_dat) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = res_diff, x = arm, group = arm, color = arm)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = res_diff, x = arm, group = arm, color = arm)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Absolute change in MLS resistance") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

### Corr: abs MLS change and tx int

```{r correlations table}

morb_cor %>%
  mutate(exp = ifelse(tx_type == "azithro", "Primary exposure", "NCE")) %>%
  dplyr::select(idw_power, exp, arm, rho, perm_p) %>%
  arrange(idw_power, exp, arm) %>%
  kable(format = "html", digits = 3, 
        col.names = c("IDW power", "Expt", "Arm", "Spearman's rho", "Permutation p-value"),
        caption = "Spearman's correlations between absolute change in MLS resistance and treatment intensity")

```

```{r Scatterplot, fig.height=8, fig.width=6}

cor_text <- morb_cor %>%
  mutate(plot_label = paste0(
    'rho == ', sprintf("%.2f", rho), 
    ' * "," ~ italic(p) == ', sprintf("%.2f", perm_p) 
  ),
  y = ifelse(arm == "azithro", 100, 85),
  plot_labelf = paste0(
    'rho == ', sprintf("%.2f", rhof), 
    ' * "," ~ italic(p) == ', sprintf("%.2f", perm_pf) 
  ),
  yf = ifelse(arm == "azithro", 20, 12),
  y_perm = ifelse(arm == "azithro", 3.5, 3)
  )

panelA <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = subset(morb_dat, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "azithro"), 
             aes(x = tx_int, y = res_diff, color = arm),
             size = 3.5,
             alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = subset(cor_text, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "azithro"), 
            aes(y = y, color = arm, label = plot_label), 
            x = 1,
            size = 5,
            hjust = 1,
            parse = TRUE,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Change in MLS resistance gene\nabundance (normalized reads/million)",
                     limits = c(-25, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     name = "Geographic treatment intensity of azithromycin") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  ggtitle("B") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    shape = 15,
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 4
  )))

panelB <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = subset(morb_dat, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "placebo"), 
             aes(x = tx_int, y = res_diff, color = arm),
             size = 3.5,
             alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = subset(cor_text, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "placebo"), 
            aes(y = y, color = arm, label = plot_label), 
            x = 1,
            size = 5,
            hjust = 1,
            parse = TRUE,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Change in MLS resistance gene\nabundance (normalized reads/million)",
                     limits = c(-25, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     name = "Geographic treatment intensity of placebo") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  ggtitle("C") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    shape = 15,
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 4
  )))

mls_change_plot <- diff_panelA / panelA / panelB +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", axes = "collect_y") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

mls_change_plot

ggsave(mls_change_plot, filename = here("figs", "manuscript", "supp-figs", "supp_fig9.png"), 
       width = 7, height = 9, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

```

### Permutation distributions

```{r abs change perm dists}

perm_combined <- bind_rows(morb_cor_dists)

ggplot(subset(perm_combined, idw_power ==1), aes(x = cor, color = arm, fill = arm)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(data = subset(morb_cor, idw_power ==1), 
             aes(xintercept = rho, color = arm),
             linetype = "dotted",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_label(data = subset(cor_text, idw_power ==1), 
            aes(color = arm, label = plot_label, y = y_perm), 
            x = 1,
            hjust = 1,
            vjust = 1,
            parse = TRUE,
            show.legend = FALSE,
            fill = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~tx_type,
             labeller = labeller(tx_type = c(`azithro` = "Primary exposure", `placebo` = "NCE"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Spearman Correlation", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Density") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Permutation Null Distributions with Observed Correlations",
    subtitle = "Correlation between absolute change in MLS and Tx int"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )

```

### Corr: fold MLS change and tx int

```{r fold change correlations table}

morb_cor %>%
  mutate(exp = ifelse(tx_type == "azithro", "Primary exposure", "NCE")) %>%
  dplyr::select(idw_power, exp, arm, rhof, perm_pf) %>%
  arrange(idw_power, exp, arm) %>%
  kable(format = "html", digits = 3, 
        col.names = c("IDW power", "Expt", "Arm", "Spearman's rho", "Permutation p-value"),
        caption = "Spearman's correlations between fold change in MLS resistance and treatment intensity")

```

```{r fold change scatterplot, fig.height=8, fig.width=6}

panelAf <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = subset(morb_dat, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "azithro"), 
             aes(x = tx_int, y = res_fold_change, color = arm),
             size = 3.5,
             alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = subset(cor_text, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "azithro"), 
            aes(y = yf, color = arm, label = plot_labelf), 
            x = 1,
            size = 5,
            hjust = 1,
            parse = TRUE,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Fold change in MLS resistance\ngene abundance (normalized reads/million)",
                     # limits = c(0, 30),
                     transform = "log2",
                     breaks = c(0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     name = "Geographic treatment intensity of azithromycin") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  ggtitle("A")

panelBf <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = subset(morb_dat, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "placebo"), 
             aes(x = tx_int, y = res_fold_change, color = arm),
             size = 3.5,
             alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = subset(cor_text, idw_power == 1 & tx_type == "placebo"), 
            aes(y = yf, color = arm, label = plot_labelf), 
            x = 1,
            size = 5,
            hjust = 1,
            parse = TRUE,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Fold change in MLS resistance\ngene abundance (normalized reads/million)",
                     # limits = c(0, 30),
                     transform = "log2",
                     breaks = c(0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     name = "Geographic treatment intensity of placebo") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Monitoring village treatment",
    breaks = c("azithro", "placebo"),
    labels = c("Azithromycin", "Placebo"),
    values = arms_colors
  ) +
  ggtitle("B")

mls_fold_change_plot <- panelAf / panelBf +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", axes = "collect_y") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

mls_fold_change_plot

ggsave(mls_change_plot, filename = here("figs", "reviewer-comments", "mls_abs_change.png"), 
       width = 6, height = 8, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
